title: Serpent
description: A grid arcade snake. Arrows or WASD steer. Eat amber fruit, avoid the walls and your tail. Enter restarts.

rules.do: repeat (3) spawn('tail', {x: 152 - i * 16, y: 184, tags: ['tail'], data: {seq: -i}})

if (!state.over) { if (pressed('left') && state.dx != 1) { state.nextX = -1; state.nextY = 0 }; if (pressed('right') && state.dx != -1) { state.nextX = 1; state.nextY = 0 }; if (pressed('up') && state.dy != 1) { state.nextX = 0; state.nextY = -1 }; if (pressed('down') && state.dy != -1) { state.nextX = 0; state.nextY = 1 } }

do: if (state.tick >= max(0.065, 0.16 - state.score * 0.0005)) { state.tick = 0; state.dx = state.nextX; state.dy = state.nextY; state.seq += 1; spawn('tail', {x: self.x, y: self.y, tags: ['tail'], data: {seq: state.seq}}); self.x += state.dx * 16; self.y += state.dy * 16; let f = get('food'); if (self.x == f.x && self.y == f.y) { state.length += 1; state.score += 10; sound('hit'); state.foodNeeded = true }; let parts = all('tail'); repeat (count('tail')) { let p = parts[i]; if (p.data.seq <= state.seq - state.length + 1) despawn(p) }; parts = all('tail'); repeat (count('tail')) { if (parts[i].x == self.x && parts[i].y == self.y) state.over = true }; if (self.x < 24 || self.x > 456 || self.y < 56 || self.y > 312) state.over = true }

rules.do: if (state.foodNeeded && !state.over) { let f = get('food'); let done = false; let offset = floor(rand(0, 476)); repeat (476) { if (!done) { let n = (offset + i) % 476; let x = 24 + (n % 28) * 16; let y = 56 + floor(n / 28) * 16; let h = get('head'); let free = x != h.x || y != h.y; let parts = all('tail'); repeat (count('tail')) { if (parts[i].x == x && parts[i].y == y) free = false }; if (free) { f.x = x; f.y = y; done = true } } }; if (!done) state.over = true; state.foodNeeded = false }
